xDiT.Preset.description: Select a hardware benchmark preset and provide defaults to Model and Sample.

gpu_tag.name: GPU Tag
gpu_tag.tooltip: Hardware tag used to filter GPU counts and presets.

gpu_count.name: GPU Count
gpu_count.tooltip: GPU count required by the preset.

preset.name: Preset
preset.tooltip: Benchmark preset for the selected hardware and GPU count.

xDiT.Model.description: Load and warm an xDiT model worker for inference.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model supported by the installed xDiT version.

task.name: Task
task.tooltip: Pipeline task for multi-task models, such as i2v or t2v. Leave empty for single-task models.

gpu_device_ids.name: GPU Device IDs
gpu_device_ids.tooltip: Comma-separated GPU indices. Specify one index per process, such as 0,1,2,3 for four processes. Use separate indices for concurrent models.

residency.name: Residency
residency.tooltip: GPU memory policy after sampling. keep_gpu retains the model until you unload it or stop ComfyUI; park_cpu moves weights to system RAM; release stops the worker after the run.

use_torch_compile.name: Use Torch Compile
use_torch_compile.tooltip: Compile supported model components with torch.compile. The first run is slower; later runs with the same configuration may be faster.

hf_cache_mode.name: HF Cache Mode
hf_cache_mode.tooltip: Hugging Face cache location. auto uses the environment, then ComfyUI/models/huggingface. custom_path uses the directory below.

hf_cache_dir.name: HF Cache Directory
hf_cache_dir.tooltip: Hugging Face cache root used when HF Cache Mode is custom_path.

scm_policy.name: SCM Policy
scm_policy.tooltip: Step computation mask for dbcache. slow computes most steps; medium, fast, and ultra progressively skip more work. default preserves the model preset.

t2_scm_policy.name: T2 SCM Policy
t2_scm_policy.tooltip: Step computation mask for dbcache. slow computes most steps; medium, fast, and ultra progressively skip more work. default preserves the model preset.

MODEL CACHE.name: MODEL CACHE
MODEL CACHE.tooltip: Show or hide MODEL CACHE settings.

ulysses_degree.name: Ulysses Degree
ulysses_degree.tooltip: Ulysses sequence parallel degree. Used in attention layer. — The first knob to reach for on multiple GPUs: set it to your GPU count. Splits attention heads across GPUs, so it needs the model's head count to divide by it.

ring_degree.name: Ring Degree
ring_degree.tooltip: Ring sequence parallel degree. Used in attention layer. — Splits the sequence instead of the heads. Combine with ulysses_degree when your GPU count does not divide the head count on its own; ulysses alone is faster.

pipefusion_parallel_degree.name: Pipefusion Parallel Degree
pipefusion_parallel_degree.tooltip: Pipefusion parallel degree. Indicates the number of pipeline stages. — Pipeline stages across GPUs. Rarely the best use of a GPU on one machine — prefer ulysses_degree.

tensor_parallel_degree.name: Tensor Parallel Degree
tensor_parallel_degree.tooltip: Tensor parallel degree. — Also saves VRAM by splitting weights, but communicates inside every layer. Try fully_shard_degree first.

text_encoder_tp_degree.name: Text Encoder TP Degree
text_encoder_tp_degree.tooltip: Tensor parallel degree for supported text encoders, reusing the existing model ranks.

data_parallel_degree.name: Data Parallel Degree
data_parallel_degree.tooltip: Data parallel degree. — Creates one model replica per data-parallel rank. This improves throughput but uses more VRAM.

use_cfg_parallel.name: Use CFG Parallel
use_cfg_parallel.tooltip: Use split batch in classifier_free_guidance. cfg_degree will be 2 if set — Runs guided and unguided passes on separate GPUs. Requires an even GPU count.

fully_shard_degree.name: Fully Shard Degree
fully_shard_degree.tooltip: Fully sharding (sharding) degree. — Raise it to save VRAM: the weights are split across this many GPUs instead of copied to each. Costs a gather per block, so use the smallest value that fits.

reshard_after_forward.name: Reshard After Forward
reshard_after_forward.tooltip: Keep parameters gathered after each block's forward instead of resharding. Trades memory for latency by eliminating repeated all-gathers. Only valid with --fully_shard_degree > 1.

memory_efficient_sharding.name: Memory Efficient Sharding
memory_efficient_sharding.tooltip: Reduce peak VRAM during load: shard transformer blocks one at a time on GPU during init, so the full unsharded component never materializes on device. Slightly slower to load - use if the model OOMs on GPU during init. Requires --fully_shard_degree > 1.

memory_efficient_replicated_load.name: Memory Efficient Replicated Load
memory_efficient_replicated_load.tooltip: Reduce peak host RAM when a model that fits one GPU is replicated across ranks (pure sequence/CFG/data parallelism): rank0 loads the real weights and peers build on meta and receive them over a GPU->GPU broadcast, so host peak is 1x the model instead of Nx. Use if the load is OOM-killed on host as rank count grows. No effect with weight-splitting parallelism (FSDP/PipeFusion/tensor parallel), which loads per-rank weights anyway, or on a single rank.

cpu_offload_mode.name: CPU Offload Mode
cpu_offload_mode.tooltip: CPU offload strategy for model components. — Moves model components to system RAM when idle. Reduces VRAM use but slows inference.

group_offload_low_cpu_mem.name: Group Offload Low CPU Mem
group_offload_low_cpu_mem.tooltip: With --enable_group_cpu_offload, pin each tensor as it is offloaded instead of pre-pinning whole components. Keeps host RAM flat on hosts where it is the binding constraint, at some of the streaming speedup.

use_parallel_vae.name: Use Parallel VAE
use_parallel_vae.tooltip: Enable parallel VAE. — Distributes VAE decoding across the selected GPUs.

use_vae_channels_last_format.name: Use VAE Channels Last Format
use_vae_channels_last_format.tooltip: Use channels last memory format for the VAE.

attention_backend.name: Attention Backend
attention_backend.tooltip: Attention backend to use. If not specified, the best available backend will be selected automatically. — auto selects a supported backend. Choose another backend for testing or compatibility.

cross_attention_backend.name: Cross Attention Backend
cross_attention_backend.tooltip: Attention backend to use for cross-attention. If not specified, falls back to --attention_backend.

use_hybrid_attn_schedule.name: Use Hybrid Attn Schedule
use_hybrid_attn_schedule.tooltip: Enable hybrid attention schedule for faster inference and improved quality. — Uses high-precision attention at the start and end of denoising.

hybrid_attn_low_precision_backend.name: Hybrid Attn Low Precision Backend
hybrid_attn_low_precision_backend.tooltip: Low-precision attention backend for hybrid schedule. If set, high-precision backend must also be set.

hybrid_attn_high_precision_backend.name: Hybrid Attn High Precision Backend
hybrid_attn_high_precision_backend.tooltip: High-precision attention backend for hybrid schedule. If set, low-precision backend must also be set.

num_hybrid_attn_high_precision_steps.name: Num Hybrid Attn High Precision Steps
num_hybrid_attn_high_precision_steps.tooltip: Number of high-precision attention steps in hybrid schedule.

hybrid_attn_schedule.name: Hybrid Attn Schedule
hybrid_attn_schedule.tooltip: An explicit comma-delimited string of attention backend names for the hybrid schedule. Example: 'FLASH_3,FLASH_3_FP8,FLASH_3_FP8,FLASH_3'. Use only if both low-precision and high-precision backends are not set.

use_ssta_sparse_text_to_image.name: Use SSTA Sparse Text To Image
use_ssta_sparse_text_to_image.tooltip: Use sparse attention for text-to-image attention path in SSTA.

spargeattn_reorder_sequence.name: Spargeattn Reorder Sequence
spargeattn_reorder_sequence.tooltip: Reorder image tokens via the gilbert space-filling curve before Sparge attention. Use --no-spargeattn_reorder_sequence to disable.

use_spargeattn_static_block_mask.name: Use Spargeattn Static Block Mask
use_spargeattn_static_block_mask.tooltip: OR a static gilbert block-neighbor mask into the dynamic Sparge block mask. Only meaningful when --spargeattn_reorder_sequence is set. Use --no-use_spargeattn_static_block_mask to disable.

use_spargeattn_head_balance.name: Use Spargeattn Head Balance
use_spargeattn_head_balance.tooltip: Balance per-rank attention work across Ulysses ranks by permuting heads (block-sparse load balancing). Only has an effect with ulysses_degree>1 and a Sparge attention backend.

vsa_block_size.name: VSA Block Size
vsa_block_size.tooltip: Query/KV block size for the AITER CK-Tile VSA backend.

vsa_top_k.name: VSA Top K
vsa_top_k.tooltip: Minimum KV blocks selected per query block by AITER VSA.

vsa_top_k_ratio.name: VSA Top K Ratio
vsa_top_k_ratio.tooltip: Minimum selected KV-block fraction for AITER VSA. For Jenga drop rate r, set this to 1-r.

vsa_drop_rates.name: VSA Drop Rates
vsa_drop_rates.tooltip: Enable Jenga's per-step sparse schedule. One value applies to all steps; two values switch after the midpoint. Drop rates <=0.25 use dense AITER attention.

vsa_prob_threshold.name: VSA Prob Threshold
vsa_prob_threshold.tooltip: Jenga cumulative probability threshold for AITER VSA.

vsa_reorder_sequence.name: VSA Reorder Sequence
vsa_reorder_sequence.tooltip: Reorder Wan video tokens with the sliced Gilbert curve before VSA.

use_vsa_static_block_mask.name: Use VSA Static Block Mask
use_vsa_static_block_mask.tooltip: Union Gilbert physical-neighbor blocks into the dynamic VSA mask.

use_vsa_first_frame_mask.name: Use VSA First Frame Mask
use_vsa_first_frame_mask.tooltip: Preserve first-frame block relations in the VSA mask.

GEMM PRECISION.name: GEMM PRECISION
GEMM PRECISION.tooltip: Show or hide GEMM PRECISION settings.

gemm_precision.name: GEMM Precision
gemm_precision.tooltip: Quantized GEMM precision used by xDiT. — Lower precision reduces memory use and may improve speed, with a possible quality cost.

use_fp8_text_encoder.name: Use FP8 Text Encoder
use_fp8_text_encoder.tooltip: Also quantize the text encoder's linear layers to FP8 (selected models only). Requires --use_fp8_gemms, which covers the transformer alone. Frees several GB for large bf16 text encoders, at whatever output-quality cost FP8 carries for the encoder; off by default because that is a quality trade-off, not a free win.

fp8_precision_override_prefix_patterns.name: FP8 Precision Override Prefix Patterns
fp8_precision_override_prefix_patterns.tooltip: Comma-delimited FQN prefix patterns to keep in FP8 during FP4 GEMMs.

fp8_precision_override_suffix_patterns.name: FP8 Precision Override Suffix Patterns
fp8_precision_override_suffix_patterns.tooltip: Comma-delimited FQN suffix patterns to keep in FP8 during FP4 GEMMs.

use_hybrid_gemm_schedule.name: Use Hybrid GEMM Schedule
use_hybrid_gemm_schedule.tooltip: Enable hybrid GEMM schedule: FP8 at start/end and MXFP4 in the middle. — Uses FP8 at the start and end of denoising and MXFP4 between them.

num_hybrid_gemm_high_precision_steps.name: Num Hybrid GEMM High Precision Steps
num_hybrid_gemm_high_precision_steps.tooltip: Number of high-precision GEMM steps at both the start and end of denoising.

STEP CACHE.name: STEP CACHE
STEP CACHE.tooltip: Show or hide STEP CACHE settings.

residual_diff_threshold.name: Residual Diff Threshold
residual_diff_threshold.tooltip: L1 residual threshold for step reuse (all cache methods). — Minimum residual difference required to recompute a step. Higher values reuse more steps.

Fn_compute_blocks.name: Fn Compute Blocks
Fn_compute_blocks.tooltip: First N blocks used to compute the L1 difference (dbcache).

Bn_compute_blocks.name: Bn Compute Blocks
Bn_compute_blocks.tooltip: TaylorSeer calibrator blocks; leave at 0 for most models.

max_warmup_steps.name: Max Warmup Steps
max_warmup_steps.tooltip: Steps before caching activates (dbcache). — Number of initial steps to run before enabling the cache.

max_cached_steps.name: Max Cached Steps
max_cached_steps.tooltip: Max cached steps (-1 = unlimited). — Maximum consecutive reused steps. -1 applies no limit.

enable_separate_cfg.name: Enable Separate CFG
enable_separate_cfg.tooltip: Separate CFG passes (Wan, Qwen-Image-Edit). default = model built-in setting.

enable_encoder_calibrator.name: Enable Encoder Calibrator
enable_encoder_calibrator.tooltip: Encoder calibrator for dbcache. default = model built-in setting.

enable_taylorseer.name: Enable Taylorseer
enable_taylorseer.tooltip: TaylorSeer prediction for dbcache. default = model built-in setting.

STEP CACHE · DENOISER 2.name: STEP CACHE · DENOISER 2
STEP CACHE · DENOISER 2.tooltip: Cache settings for the second transformer in dual-transformer models. The main Step Cache settings apply to the first transformer.

t2_residual_diff_threshold.name: T2 Residual Diff Threshold
t2_residual_diff_threshold.tooltip: L1 residual threshold for step reuse (all cache methods). — Minimum residual difference required to recompute a step. Higher values reuse more steps.

t2_Fn_compute_blocks.name: T2 Fn Compute Blocks
t2_Fn_compute_blocks.tooltip: First N blocks used to compute the L1 difference (dbcache).

t2_Bn_compute_blocks.name: T2 Bn Compute Blocks
t2_Bn_compute_blocks.tooltip: TaylorSeer calibrator blocks; leave at 0 for most models.

t2_max_warmup_steps.name: T2 Max Warmup Steps
t2_max_warmup_steps.tooltip: Steps before caching activates (dbcache). — Number of initial steps to run before enabling the cache.

t2_max_cached_steps.name: T2 Max Cached Steps
t2_max_cached_steps.tooltip: Max cached steps (-1 = unlimited). — Maximum consecutive reused steps. -1 applies no limit.

t2_enable_separate_cfg.name: T2 Enable Separate CFG
t2_enable_separate_cfg.tooltip: Separate CFG passes (Wan, Qwen-Image-Edit). default = model built-in setting.

t2_enable_encoder_calibrator.name: T2 Enable Encoder Calibrator
t2_enable_encoder_calibrator.tooltip: Encoder calibrator for dbcache. default = model built-in setting.

t2_enable_taylorseer.name: T2 Enable Taylorseer
t2_enable_taylorseer.tooltip: TaylorSeer prediction for dbcache. default = model built-in setting.

DISTILLED WEIGHTS.name: DISTILLED WEIGHTS
DISTILLED WEIGHTS.tooltip: Local LightX2V transformer files for Wan 2.2 Distilled I2V. Ignored by other models.

distilled_transformer_path.name: Distilled Transformer Path
distilled_transformer_path.tooltip: Wan 2.2 Distilled I2V only. Path to the high-noise LightX2V transformer file.

distilled_transformer_2_path.name: Distilled Transformer 2 Path
distilled_transformer_2_path.tooltip: Wan 2.2 Distilled I2V only. Path to the low-noise LightX2V transformer file.

preset.name: Preset
preset.tooltip: Optional preset defaults for model and runtime settings. Local values can override them.

xDiT.Sample.description: Generate images or video with a warmed xDiT model.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Warm xDiT runtime from xDiT Model.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Text describing the requested output. Changing it does not reload the model.

negative_prompt.name: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.tooltip: Text describing content to avoid. Empty uses the model default.

output_fps.name: Output FPS
output_fps.tooltip: Playback FPS for VIDEO output. 0 uses the model-native FPS.

enable_tiling.name: Enable VAE Tiling
enable_tiling.tooltip: Enable VAE tiling to save GPU memory. — Decodes in tiles to reduce peak VAE memory use.

enable_slicing.name: Enable VAE Slicing
enable_slicing.tooltip: Decode one batch item at a time to reduce GPU memory use. This has no effect when the batch size is 1. — Decodes batch items individually to reduce peak VAE memory use.

width.name: Width
width.tooltip: Output width in 8-pixel increments. Larger values use more VRAM.

height.name: Height
height.tooltip: Output height in 8-pixel increments. Larger values use more VRAM.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Initial noise seed. Reuse it with the same settings for repeatable output.

num_inference_steps.name: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.tooltip: Number of denoising steps. More steps increase run time; use the preset default.

guidance_scale.name: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.tooltip: Prompt guidance strength. Higher values follow the prompt more strictly.

Video.name: VIDEO
Video.tooltip: Show or hide video-only generation settings.

num_frames.name: Num Frames
num_frames.tooltip: Frame count for video models. Leave at 1 for still images.

resize_input_images.name: Resize Input Images
resize_input_images.tooltip: Ask supported image-conditioned models to resize/crop references to the requested size. When disabled, Wan i2v preserves reference aspect ratio within the requested pixel area.

max_sequence_length.name: Max Sequence Length
max_sequence_length.tooltip: Maximum prompt tokens processed by the text encoder. Higher values use more memory.

timeout_seconds.name: Run Timeout
timeout_seconds.tooltip: Maximum time for model loading and one generation run. This does not unload an idle model.

VAE.name: VAE DECODE
VAE.tooltip: Show or hide VAE decoding and tiling settings.

vae_tile_size_height.name: VAE Tile Size Height
vae_tile_size_height.tooltip: Exact output-pixel height of each VAE tile. Requires --enable_tiling. Must be used with --vae_tile_size_width.

vae_tile_size_width.name: VAE Tile Size Width
vae_tile_size_width.tooltip: Exact output-pixel width of each VAE tile. Requires --enable_tiling. Must be used with --vae_tile_size_height.

vae_tile_overlap_height.name: VAE Tile Overlap Height
vae_tile_overlap_height.tooltip: Exact VAE tile overlap along the height axis, in output pixels. Requires --enable_tiling. Must be used with --vae_tile_overlap_width. Height and width may differ; use 0 for an inactive strip axis.

vae_tile_overlap_width.name: VAE Tile Overlap Width
vae_tile_overlap_width.tooltip: Exact VAE tile overlap along the width axis, in output pixels. Requires --enable_tiling. Must be used with --vae_tile_overlap_height. Height and width may differ; use 0 for an inactive strip axis.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Reference images for image-conditioned tasks such as edit, i2i, or i2v.

preset.name: Preset
preset.tooltip: Optional preset defaults for generation settings. Local values can override them.
